name: Pixelix
tagline: A mobile client for Pixelfed and Vernissage
blurb: Pixelix is an open source client for the Fediverse photo sharing platforms Pixelfed and Vernissage.
description:
Pixelix is an open source client for the Fediverse photo sharing platforms Pixelfed and Vernissage.

- Material Design
- Multi-accounts support
- Dark and light theme
- Profile settings
- Home / local / global timelines
- Trending posts, trending hashtags, trending profiles
- Custom app icons
- Post templates
- Open source

install.label: F-Droid
install.note: Adds F-Droid as an update source, so you keep getting updates.

install.note: Signed APK straight from the F-Droid repository.
